Overtown CRA Housing Map
Southeast Overtown / Park West CRA · Miami, FL

Housing the Overtown CRA has funded, partnered on, or has in the pipeline

Each pin is a housing project with documented funding, land or a development deal from the Southeast Overtown/Park West Community Redevelopment Agency (SEOPW CRA). Click a pin or a row for the developer, CRA dollars, stories, units, income levels and timing. Figures come from CRA project pages and news coverage through November 2026; blanks mean the number has not been published.

Also on the books, no mappable site yet

    About the numbers

    CRA $ disclosed adds only dollar amounts the CRA or press published for a project, each counted once. Courtside's $7.5M is treated as covering both phases, so the $3M Phase II bond money is not added on top. Mama Hattie's House counts the lower $5M figure, and the Quadplex counts $1.6M although the CRA page may say $2.7M. Rainbow Village, Atlantic Square, The Walker and the bond-funded sites have CRA money or land behind them with no published figure, so the true total is higher. The CRA says it has put more than $150M into housing and committed over $90M from its $175M 2025 bond.

    CRA role: "Direct CRA funding" has a documented CRA dollar commitment. "CRA land, bond or partner" names the CRA as a partner or landowner without a figure. Only projects with documented Southeast Overtown/Park West CRA money, land or a CRA-run deal are shown; projects funded only by other agencies are left out.

    CRA-funded units: no project publishes a separate count of units paid for by the CRA. Where the CRA invested in a building that is 100% affordable, every unit is covered by that deal, and the map says "all units". Atlantic Square is the one mixed-income case with a stated CRA share: 40 affordable units. Photos come from the CRA's project pages and the news outlets credited on each image; renderings are labeled.

    Dashed pins mark approximate locations.
